author: Subscriptor
body:
Heyo everybody!

I've remixed the awesome map, Sector Six. 

Name: Sector Six : Remix

Gamemode: Nebula, CTW

Original creator: Darkiur_

Remixed by: MapDev

Version: 1.0

Changelog: 
-add:
-remove:

Images: http://imgur.com/a/uBlPc

Download: http://www.mediafire.com/download/oj9t7d49obdu7kd/e.rar

YML: Coming soon.

This is a Capture The Wool version of the map that has good gameplay, since I saw in Sector Six a great potential for a CTW map, and I remixed it. I reduced the void gap a bit, connected wool to the paths, I added some more traps at the connections, added cool stuff to the wool, and some other cool features. Hope you like it, and feedback is always appreciated.

replies.author: UmbreonMessiah
replies.body:
Looks awesome! +1
Although I can see people saying:
Too similar to the old one. (Disagree)
New blocks could be nice. (Agree, but still good atm.)
Spawn is a bit plain. (Agree)

In general I think this would be an awesome remix, if you maybe changed up the blocks a bit? Not sure though. I'm no expert.

replies.body:
Thank you for the feedback. Took into considiration.

I made it abit similar to the old one since the old one was perfect, but I could see it being played much better in a CTW gamemode.
New blocks, will do if I see more people think that.
However I disagree about the spawn, I think the spawn is pretty good but I'll change it too if I see that many people think that.

Thank you for your feedback! :)

replies.author: Fouled
replies.body:
Sorry! :(

We're sorry to announce that your map has been denied for testing on the Avicus Network. The reasons are the following:

- For the remix, the map is too similar. As in, the only thing that was added were the extra pathways to the monument locations. Which could also resolve in some easy game-play situations.

You may rework your map and update it so we can re-evaluate it. Please use only one forum submission per map, update this thread once you're done. Good luck!

Overall Score:
Gameplay: 7/10
Aesthetics: 8.5/10
Creativity: 7/10

Thanks for your map submission! :D
